prompt.text:
Implement a new self-contained TypeScript text utility module. Export constants `DIGITS = 1`, `UPPER = 2`, `LOWER = 4`, and `PUNCTUATION = 8`, plus `alphabet`, `characterAt`, `repeatText`, and `toNarrowAscii`. `alphabet(flags)` concatenates enabled sets in the order digits, uppercase ASCII, lowercase ASCII, then `-_.`, and throws `RangeError` if flags contain unknown bits or enable no set. `characterAt(index, flags)` returns the alphabet character at the zero-based integer index and throws `RangeError` for a negative, non-integer, or out-of-range index. `repeatText(value, count)` accepts only non-negative integer counts and otherwise throws `RangeError`; zero returns `''`. `toNarrowAscii(value)` converts full-width ASCII characters U+FF01 through U+FF5E to U+0021 through U+007E and U+3000 to an ASCII space, leaving all other code points unchanged. Inputs are never mutated. Return one complete source file with exact TypeScript exports.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
